cells.value: General Checks
IHQMOD(N) approved WLD (Electrical and Construction) / Board proceedings / AFDs
Set of certificates
All Equipment / units have been installed in accordance with approved drawings
Compartment lighting operational
All Equipment / units have been secured correctly, fasteners tightened / shock and vibration mounts in place as per approved drawings
Maintenance envelope is available for all units
All Equipment / units are free from any physical damage and corrosion, also check for completeness
Device Tally / Equipment Tally on bulkhead / deck
Rubber mats are provided in front of all high voltage units
Internal communication between all relevant positions
Cabling Checks
All Cables have been laid as per specifications in accordance with approved cable wiring diagram
All cables are labelled with metallic tallies secured with copper wire, marked correctly and readable. Metallic sleeve tallies are provided on Fibre Optical Cables
Termination of cables, crimping and tightness of screws, correct stripping of wires and that no naked wire exists. Ferrules are provided at the terminations
Terminals entering the junction box gland are packed
Cable runs are properly clamped & cable trays are provided wherever applicable
Condition of cables is satisfactory & have no sign of damage, uneven joints or temporary connections
Cables running through conduits / pipes connected to units are packed by yellow compound / packing material. Conduits and pipes are not damaged / corroded / rusted
Booting up of cables
All external interface cabling laid and connected as per drawing
Check for cable if any, laid through flexible / fixed PVC conduits. All PVC / Plastic conduits are to be removed
Check for covering of cable run / cable channel trays with wire meshes if any. Wire meshes if provided to be removed
Equipment Cabinets / Consoles
Limit stops for drawers & sliding assemblies
Control knobs are provided & functional
Keys & special tools are provided as required
Fuses are of correct rating & spare fuses are placed in cabinets, where applicable
Access doors / windows / openings are provided with moisture proof gaskets
Earthing and bonding of equipment carried out and no paint is present on contact points
Power supply to the equipment / unit has been provided from the specified source as per approved drawings
Labelling of the fuse panels / power distribution board indicating the appropriate services (Mimic diagram) where applicable
Check all mechanical limiters / stoppers have been installed
Grease nipples are not choked and grease has been applied to the working surface, where applicable
Weapon lifting gears / raising / lowering arrangement and special tools are in place
Load certificate for lifting / raising / lowering arrangement provided
Chilled water cooling pipes are lagged, where provided
Availability of Documentation and OBD spares (Certificate to be provided by SS)
